title: Pericyte heterogeneity and functional plasticity in tumor metastasis: Mechanisms, therapeutic paradoxes and future directions (Review).
snippet: Pericytes are important components of the vascular wall and play a crucial role in maintaining vascular structure and function. title: Hydrogen sulfide in colorectal cancer: mechanisms, roles, and therapeutic potential.
snippet: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is an endogenous gasotransmitter. The effect of H2S in colorectal cancer depends on the balance between its biosynthesis and mitochondrial clearance via sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase.
